bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to adopt analytics and ML capabilities without compromising compliance posture.
Established a shared-responsibility operating model framework clarifying AWS versus insurer-owned controls to standardize secure cloud adoption.
Led AWS modernization execution to migrate monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads to cloud architecture.
